{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies CMakeLists.txt and cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in to configure and validate CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR and CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes packaging and install layout issues for distributions with nonstandard libexec directories. The description notes that on systems such as Arch Linux that set CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR to 'lib', the wrapper fails to locate internal binaries."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/bitcoin.cpp and its build glue, which is the process-dispatching bitcoin wrapper explicitly covered by IPC.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Enables the bitcoin wrapper to reliably spawn internal target processes on distributions with custom install layouts. Without this change, the wrapper fails immediately with execvp 'No such file or directory'."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/bitcoin.cpp and adds test/functional/tool_bitcoin.py, which cover the bitcoin wrapper CLI tool.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves a path lookup failure in the bitcoin wrapper CLI tool. The tool fails on distributions where libexec binaries are installed outside the hardcoded paths."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
